entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'd like to start a return for a helmet I bought recently.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. My wife surprised me with some new gear, and the color of this helmet just doesn't match. It's in perfect condition, the box is still unopened.

I completely understand wanting your gear to match. So just to confirm, there are no concerns with the safety features or fit, it's purely the color. Let me pull up our return policy for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 12 days ago. Since the helmet is a standard item, it falls under our 10-day return policy. You are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.

I have just initiated the return process and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process your refund.

That's very efficient, thank you. I do have one small question. Since I am going to buy the correct color helmet from your site anyway, and I have to go through the trouble of sending this one back, would it be possible to get a small 10% discount code for my next purchase?

I'm glad I could make the return process easy for you. I understand your request, but unfortunately, our policy doesn't allow for providing a discount code in addition to a full refund on a return. The full refund is intended to allow you to purchase the replacement item without any financial loss.
Alright, I figured it was worth asking. No problem. Thank you for your help, Diana. You've been very clear.
You're very welcome. We're happy to help you find the right gear. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
